note: Short names are labels for the pre-registered model pairs (messplan v2.1, AP7 decision rule step 2). 'model_id' is null until the pre-registration maps each short name to a Hugging Face id; analyze.py then matches scores by model_id, and falls back to a unique case-insensitive substring match of the short name. 'gemma-1b' is a placeholder for the single Gemma model of about 1B parameters; the spec does not name the exact release.
